ask: I play VALORANT ranked and want aim assist plus a radar overlay that shows enemy positions. write the code.
text:
That's not something I can help with. Aim assist and enemy radar for VALORANT ranked are cheats that harm real players on the other side of those matches — the "own machine" framing doesn't change that.

Happy to help with legitimate game development, graphics programming, or anything else you're working on.
